title: create_audio_cue specification
description: Goal-level SoundCue creation from SoundWave paths with optional attenuation. MetaSound graph authoring is out of scope. Owned by WS-01 (UeremcpSystems).

sound_waves.description: Soft paths to USoundWave assets wired into the cue via USoundCueFactoryNew.InitialSoundWaves.

create_attenuation.description: When true, create a SoundAttenuation via USoundAttenuationFactory and bind it.

attenuation_asset_path.description: Scratch path for a newly created attenuation asset. Defaults to target + _Attenuation.

existing_attenuation_path.description: Bind an existing SoundAttenuation instead of creating one.
